newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa profits surge 20 pct in 1st quarter.
newsitem.headline: Degussa profits surge 20 pct in 1st quarter.

text.p: German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG on Tuesday said profits jumped 20 percent during the first quarter confirming the group's earlier-made prediction that business conditions would improve.

In the first three months of the 1996/1997 business year, which ends on September 30, Degussa reported a 20 percent increase in pre-tax profits. It did not reveal the actual numbers however and gave no specific reasons for the rise.
The group has scheduled a news conference for 0900 GMT to detail results.
Sales for the first quarter climbed 16 percent or six percent excluding precious metal trading, Degussa said in a mandatory bourse statement.

For the 1995/1996 business year, the group reported a two percent rise in pre-tax profits and predicted that the marked improvement in conditions seen late in the year would continue into the next business year.
